# Fjarholm

> Official website of Fjarholm — independent geometric digital art, architectural concepts, and vector illustrations inspired by Nordic nature.

## Overview

Fjarholm explores architecture, vector illustration, and minimalist pastel art through a visual language inspired by Nordic nature, simplicity, and balance.

## Main Pages

- **Home:** [fjarholm.com](https://fjarholm.com/)
- **Gallery:** [fjarholm.com/gallery.html](https://fjarholm.com/gallery.html)
- **Info:** [fjarholm.com/info.html](https://fjarholm.com/info.html)

## Content & Focus

The website contains original artworks, architectural concepts, vector silhouettes, and pastel artworks created and curated by Fjarholm.
